The test image shows soybean leaves with dark brown/black irregular lesions, yellowing around some lesions, and holes where dead tissue has fallen out giving a ragged appearance. This is a **leaf** disease.

Top candidates based on symptoms: Bacterial_Blight (angular lesions, ragged appearance), Septoria_brown_spot, Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Cercospora, Downy_mildew, Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Bacterial_Pustule.

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with Bacterial_Blight.
Bacterial_Blight reference shows smaller yellow-green spots on younger plants. The test image has more advanced, darker lesions with more yellowing. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria reference shows yellowed leaf with small scattered dark spots. The test image has somewhat larger, more irregular lesions. Let me check Frogeye_leaf_spot.
Frogeye shows distinct small circular spots with gray centers and dark borders on green leaves. Doesn't match the test image. Let me check Cercospora.
Cercospora shows reddish-brown/purple spots densely scattered across a yellowing leaf with some holes. This has some similarity to the test image. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus next.
SVN shows localized yellow spots along veins on otherwise green leaves. Doesn't match the widespread yellowing in the test image. Let me check Downy_mildew.
Downy mildew shows light green/yellow speckled spots on otherwise darker green leaves. The test image has larger dark lesions and more generalized yellowing. Let me check Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus.
BPMV shows leaf puckering and green-yellow mottling. Doesn't match the test image. Let me use my final view on Bacterial_Pustule.

Now I've viewed all 8 references across 8 different classes. Let me synthesize.

**Test image features:**
- Soybean leaves with significant yellowing/chlorosis extending well beyond lesion areas
- Dark brown/black irregular spots scattered across leaf surfaces
- Some holes where dead tissue has fallen out
- Appears to be mid-to-lower canopy
- Yellowing is widespread, not confined just around lesions

**Comparison with references:**
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Early-stage yellow spots; test image is more advanced with different lesion pattern
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Closest match - yellowed leaf with small irregular dark brown spots, yellowing extending far beyond lesions
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Circular spots with gray centers on green leaves - doesn't match
- **Cercospora**: Reddish-purple spots, similar but more reddish tones than test image
- **SVN**: Localized vein-associated spots - doesn't match
- **Downy_mildew**: Even speckled pattern - doesn't match
- **BPMV**: Puckering/mottling - doesn't match
- **Bacterial_Pustule**: Small raised spots on green leaves - doesn't match

The key diagnostic feature is "leaf yellowing expands far beyond the necrotic region" which is a hallmark of Septoria brown spot and clearly visible in the test image. The irregular dark brown lesions on yellowing leaves in the lower canopy strongly match this disease.
